system.description: When you would see a creature within 90 feet of you cast a Ninjutsu that would deal damage of any type, you may as a reaction cast a Ninjutsu you know with a casting time of 1 action. When you do, if the jutsu you cast doesn’t have the clash keyword it gains the clash keyword. You automatically initiate a clash with the triggering creatures jutsu even if their jutsu doesn’t have the clash keyword.
